source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not directly runnable with a single stock high-level command: PWR_STBY_HSC requires raw/implementation-specific IPMI bytes + exact expected output which the library has not specified; give exact bytes/result to run.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED because GPU stress has no documented causal link to standby HSC power.

original_test_intent: Validate the standby HSC power rail's normal variation, limits and protection, but the source does not define a stimulus that can legitimately change standby power.
original_method: The source boots OS, loads a GPU driver and stresses a module while reading PWR_STBY_HSC through IPMI.
manual_activity: After source correction, engineer establishes the intended standby power state and approves a causal stimulus; automation may then collect the rail evidence.
required_inputs: Definition and ownership of STBY_HSC rail
Read interface, units, limits and expected protection/recovery
safety_requirements: Do not use unrelated GPU stress to infer standby-rail behavior.
Do not transition power state or load an always-on rail without an approved power-tree plan.
Stop on management/power instability; no automatic retry.
Preserve first failure and maintain recovery access.
agent_execution_scope: Only after correction, automate the resolved state transition/stimulus and synchronized power/SEL evidence.
Do not invent rail coupling or verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct the power-state/stimulus semantics and approve limits/recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No executable command is supplied and no raw bytes may be guessed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No modernization until the source identifies a causal standby-rail stimulus; then use documented telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PWR_STBY_HSC, copied OS/driver/stress method, script and 5/10 minutes remain as source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define the standby state and HSC rail load path, select a bounded causal stimulus, capture baseline/stimulus/recovery and protection behavior.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces an unproven GPU-load coupling with a defined standby stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Avoids false evidence from the wrong domain.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect standby loading can reset management or remove recovery.

project_override_considerations: An override must explicitly define the standby rail and stimulus; a GPU load alone cannot be claimed as this case.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items require a standby HSC power sensor, while Procedure mandates booted-OS GPU-driver stress without any documented standby-rail coupling. The operation cannot presently prove the named target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This is not merely a missing parameter: the only prescribed stimulus belongs to a different operating domain, so executing it could produce irrelevant evidence while disturbing the wrong hardware.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees no runnable command exists but did not expose the semantic mismatch.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines the exact unblock decision and prevents false causal inference.

review_improvement: Requires a power-state-correct stimulus before any standby-rail result is accepted.
independent_technical_reasoning: A standby rail may remain active independent of GPU workload; without a power-tree relationship, observed change or non-change under GPU stress has no valid acceptance meaning.
